description: Eval cases for the full system (specification section 5.2). Each is run end to end by tests/app/test_eval_cases.py and tests/app/test_dashboard.py; step-by-step instructions are in demo/.

cases.title: Clean run: married filing jointly, both 65+, one W-2 image, four typed-in forms
cases.command: python run.py session --session eval1 --w2 demo/w2_image_1.jpg --forms demo/eval_case_1_forms.json --offline --answers demo/eval_case_1_answers.txt

cases.title: Human in the loop: spouse died during 2025 (filing-status ambiguity, spec 4.4 condition 5)
cases.command: python run.py session --session eval2 --w2 demo/w2_image_1.jpg --forms demo/eval_case_1_forms.json --offline --answers demo/eval_case_2_answers.txt
